name: David Citadel Hotel
insider_take: This luxury Jerusalem landmark sits at the crossroads of ancient history and modern sophistication, where you can watch the sunset paint the Old City walls golden from your room.
whats_special: The David Citadel Hotel boasts the largest spa in Jerusalem and features stunning views of both the Old City walls and the Tower of David. Built on the former no-man's land between East and West Jerusalem, it's perfectly positioned between the historic Old City and vibrant Mamilla pedestrian mall. The hotel's rooftop terrace offers unparalleled 360-degree views of Jerusalem's skyline.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 8-11 facing east for the best Old City views, and time your arrival for Thursday evening to catch the magical pre-Shabbat atmosphere in nearby Mamilla Mall.
dont_miss: A sunrise walk to the nearby Jaffa Gate (just 2 minutes away), shopping at the upscale Mamilla Mall, and experiencing the hotel's acclaimed Seasons restaurant with its panoramic terrace overlooking the ancient city walls. The Tower of David Museum is literally next door, offering world-class light shows projected onto the citadel walls.
pros: Prime location near Old City and major Jerusalem attractions
Luxurious rooms with panoramic city views
Outstanding kosher dining options and room service
cons: Busy tourist area with potential crowds
